name: frac-scope-change-request
description: Turns a "could you also" into a scope change request for a fractional engagement, with the ask in one line, the charter or statement of work line it touches, the impact in days and fee at your rates, four options (accept and price, defer, swap, decline), the decider and date, and a change log entry. Use for "run frac-scope-change-request", "could you also", "scope creep on my retainer", "is this in scope", "write a change request", "price this extra ask", "how do I say this is outside my days", part of the Claude for Fractional Leaders Pack by 90n.
